Apple TV 的订阅价格可能 再次 上调，但考虑到该流媒体服务在 9 月推出的内容，这一变化并不令人意外。延续其对高质量 Apple TV 原创内容的承诺，即将发布的剧集列表可谓星光熠熠。
你可以查看下文中 9 月在平台上首播的内容，或直接跳转到按日期排列的完整发布时间表。
9 月 Apple TV 新内容
呼救Mayday - 9 月 4 日
呼救Mayday 被描述为一部背景设定在冷战巅峰时期的动作喜剧电影。由瑞安·雷诺兹（Ryan Reynolds）饰演代号为“刺客”的美国海军王牌飞行员特洛伊·凯利中尉，他被困在敌后。他被前克格勃特工尼古拉·乌斯季诺夫（肯尼思·布拉纳饰）发现，而后者恰好对美国文化情有独钟。结果就是一部不寻常的特工搭档电影，旨在将动作与喜剧融合。
Last Seen - 9 月 9 日首播
九月首部 Apple TV 新剧是根据瑞恩·大卫·雅恩（Ryan David Jahn）的小说《调度员》（The Dispatcher）改编的六部分剧集。故事讲述了前侦探伊恩·里德利（帕特里克·布拉莫尔饰），自从十多年前女儿玛吉失踪后，他的生活一直一团糟。现在里德利担任警察调度员，当他接到一名十几岁女孩的求救电话时，他认为那可能就是他失踪已久的女儿。
你可能会认出布拉莫尔是今年《穿普拉达的女王 2》中的澳大利亚男主角。
Slow Horses Season 6 - 9 月 16 日首播
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260830/iTGQtMbubhyCffk.jpg
Slow Horses 本月进入第六季，但它已经正式续订了第七季。如果你还没有深入观看这部剧，现在入坑永远不晚。加里·奥德曼（Gary Oldman）在《锅匠，裁缝，士兵，间谍》中的精彩表现几乎延续到了这部剧集中。以下是对第一季首播的评价：
“Apple TV 的 Slow Horses 首播奠定了一部尖锐的谍战惊悚片的基调，核心是加里·奥德曼的精彩表演。这部及时的剧集融合了黑色幽默和紧张的动作，为该类型剧集带来了新颖的群戏演绎。” —— 萨曼莎·纳尔逊
对于那些追进度的观众，最新的 Slow Horses Season 6 预告片展现了奥利维亚·库克（Olivia Cooke）饰演的粉丝人气角色的回归。
圆滚地球变四方?! 数码方块地球防卫军 EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS - 9 月 23 日首播

你可能多年来一直看到有关马修·麦康纳（Matthew McConaughey）和伍迪·哈里森（Woody Harrelson）实际上有血缘关系的传闻。虽然两人从未公开确认过这一点，但他们似乎正在利用这些传闻合作这部新剧。圆滚地球变四方?! 数码方块地球防卫军 EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS 是一部喜剧，麦康纳和哈里森在剧中扮演虚构版本的自己。剧集探讨了两人的友谊，以及当他们可能是亲兄弟的秘密被揭开时会发生什么。

items.title: EA Motive的钢铁人游戏揭晓虽“未按计划进行”，但此次泄密却让漫威粉丝比以往任何时候都更加兴奋。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260830/fkFwaVbubhyCdun.png
EA Motive Studio 的 钢铁人 游戏遭遇了意外泄露，但这可能反而让漫威粉丝们比以往任何时候都更加兴奋。
钢铁人
角色扮演
查看更多 立即下载
游戏界的泄露通常被视为坏事。看看 GTA6，那款游戏的泄露规模之大，迫使 Rockstar 忙于收拾残局。然而，当本周早些时候 Motive 的 钢铁人 游戏预告片遭到泄露时，EA 选择了一种稍微不同的方式来处理这次意外的实机展示。

与 GTA6 不同，钢铁人 只需要应对一次受控的（且处于早期开发阶段的）幕后预览，粉丝们得以仔细研究每一秒的素材。看到托尼·斯塔克在摩天大楼间穿梭，并在神盾局螺旋航母上躲避敌人，是目前为止我们看到的最多的内容。考虑到损害已经造成，EA 决定以此取乐。就在视频片段开始在社交媒体上传播几小时后，EA 建立了一个新的官方 X/Twitter 账号并分享了一条诙谐的信息。结果呢？数百万次观看和数十万次互动。
“好吧，这并没按计划进行。但现在你们知道了，我们还有很多东西要展示给你们。准备好后见。” —— Marvel's 钢铁人 (@ironmangame) 2026年8月28日
“好吧，这并没按计划进行，”EA 的这条帖子写道，在本文发布时已拥有 1480 万次观看和 19.8 万次点赞。“但现在你们知道了，我们还有很多东西要展示给你们。准备好后见。”
此前曾有人担心 EA 在 2024 年调动 Motive 去协助 战地风云6 团队时，已经悄悄搁置了其 钢铁人 游戏。距离最初公布已经快四年了，期间的更新少之又少。

动作, 射击, 现代, 军事
量大管饱..
查看更多 立即下载
这种规模的开发中游戏泄露本可能被视为负面消息——对于 EA 来说，也许现在依然如此。但对于多年来一直期待看到一款单人 钢铁人 游戏外观、玩法和音效的人来说，这个时机再好不过了。
“Motive 看到他们的 钢铁人 预告片泄露，但每个人都喜欢它并为他们加油时的样子” —— CBK (@cb_keenan) 2026年8月29日
“是的，预告片泄露了，那又怎样？我们正在憋大招，现在所有人都知道了” —— Riley Studios (@RileyStudiosYT) 2026年8月29日
“利用泄露来为自己造势而不是忽视它？？？” —— 👑ℂℍ𝔸𝕆𝕊𝕂𝕀𝔻👑 (@DatChaosGuy) 2026年8月29日
“Motive 在成功将游戏泄露转化为免费营销后的感受” —— autist (@litteralyme0) 2026年8月29日
“哭死，”一条热门回复写道。“神级回应。冲鸭！”
“钢铁人 被黑然后顺势收割一波流量，这太符合角色人设了，”另一位粉丝表示。
“看，这才是处理泄露的正确方式，”另一人补充道。“拥抱它并继续打磨。而不是把头埋进沙子里。”
这条在周五突然发布的帖子下面有着海量的正面回应。许多人也紧扣主题，表示以这种方式承认泄露感觉就像是托尼·斯塔克会做出的举动。
距离我们上一次听到来自 死亡空间：重制版 和 星球大战：战机中队 开发商的新项目消息已经很久了，以至于不难发现有人根本不知道竟然有一款单人 钢铁人 体验在开发中。对他们来说，这简直就是一款史上最受欢迎的漫威超级英雄之一的全新游戏官宣。
“我们真的要迎来一整部 钢铁人 个人游戏了” —— Mandevil (@Mandevil23) 2026年8月28日
“它没有被取消！” —— Medal (@Medal_TV) 2026年8月28日
虽然尚不清楚泄露的素材是何时录制的，也不清楚距离正式发布还有多久，但网上的粉丝们似乎对 EA 和 Motive 的 钢铁人 游戏的雏形非常满意。部分视频片段暗示了装甲自定义和腕部激光攻击将成为游戏体验的一部分。几个转瞬即逝的瞬间还预示着詹姆斯·罗德斯/战争机器和佩珀·波茨等漫威漫画角色也可能出现在这场看起来像是环球冒险的旅程中。
“你知道有趣的是什么吗，”另一位网友说道，“我觉得这次泄露可能帮了他们，因为我看到的都是压倒性的正面评价。”
“他们的回应很棒，素材看起来也很火爆，”另一人说。“忍不住想支持他们。”
尽管泄露确实是真的，但我们所看到的某些甚至全部内容在最终版本发布前都有可能被删减。EA Motive 的 钢铁人 游戏目前还没有发布日期，也没有公布首发平台。虽然我们不会在这里分享泄露的视频，但可以确认这些片段依然存在，而且你可能不需要费多大力气就能找到它们。
了解更多信息，你可以查看 钢铁人 如何随着《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》重映回归影院。你也可以阅读关于 Avalanche Studios 被取消的 钢铁人 游戏，该游戏近期也遭遇了泄露。

items.title: 安妮·海瑟薇将搭档汤姆·克鲁斯出演《雷霆壮志》续集

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260830/eermmgbubhsaDAo.jpg
安妮·海瑟薇将与汤姆·克鲁斯共同主演《雷霆壮志》的续集。
克鲁斯于周六在社交媒体上宣布了海瑟薇加盟的消息，首先发布了一张他与海瑟薇的先导海报，并预告影片将于2028年夏季上映。
随后克鲁斯还发布了一段与海瑟薇的互动，这位正处于孕期的奥斯卡影后表示，她将先迎来宝宝的出生，随后再投入到电影的拍摄中。
派拉蒙影业紧随其后发布了官方新闻稿，透露《雷霆壮志》续集将采用IMAX摄影机拍摄。影片定于2028年6月2日在全球院线上映，包括IMAX、4DX和杜比影院等顶级大银幕格式。
“汤姆·克鲁斯将回归扮演纳斯卡赛车手科尔·特里克，安妮·海瑟薇则加盟饰演一名车队老板兼工程师。这部备受期待的续作是继1990年那部彻底改变电影界的开创性影片之后的又一力作。克鲁斯将与杰瑞·布鲁克海默、汤米·哈珀共同主演并担任制片人。乔纳森·莱文将执导本片，剧本由威尔·斯塔普斯操刀。”
导演乔纳森·莱文此前的代表作包括《抗癌我最大》、《长路漫漫》、《僵尸哪有那么帅》、《圣诞节前夜》以及《众神之怒》。他的下一部作品是根据真实事件改编的体育剧情片《无关紧要先生：约翰·塔格尔的故事》，由“新超人”大卫·科伦斯韦主演。
安妮·海瑟薇目前活跃在银幕上的作品有《橡树街的尽头》以及克里斯托弗·诺兰执导的《奥德赛》。接下来她将出演惊悚片《真理》。海瑟薇在今年的其他作品还包括《穿普拉达的女王2》和《圣母玛利亚》。
汤姆·克鲁斯的下一部作品是导演亚历杭德罗·冈萨雷斯·伊纳里图执导的末日喜剧《挖掘者》，克鲁斯称其为“完全原创”的作品，且与他以往拍摄的任何电影都大不相同。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260830/fMGULXbubhsaBul.png
CD Projekt Red 证实，即使索尼在 2028 年停止支持光盘，巫师4 仍将为实体游戏收藏家保留“实体盒”。

工作室联合首席执行官 Michał Nowakowski 在接受 The Game Business 采访时确认，这家曾开发 赛博朋克2077：往日之影 的工作室仍计划发行实体版。他承认，在索尼停止生产 PlayStation 实体光盘的计划上，CD Projekt Red 没有控制权，但他们仍有能力让 巫师4 对收藏家来说显得与众不同。

“我们不知道具体情况会如何，”他说，“我们知道 PlayStation 宣布了什么。我们对第一方的政策没有影响力。包括 PlayStation 在内的第一方光盘必须在他们自己的工厂生产。所以，如果他们确实在 2028 年前停止生产，那么是的，[我们将没有光盘]。”
索尼此前宣布了停止生产 PlayStation 实体游戏的计划，该举措将于 2028 年 1 月起生效。对于那些花了几十年时间收集心爱游戏光盘的玩家来说，这是一个沉重的打击，尤其是当之前预期会有实体支持的游戏在发售时却没有光盘，这会让人感到格外痛苦。
当 CD Projekt Red 暗示 巫师4 目标在 2028 年发布时，它也成为了受影响的作品之一。该工作室以在实体版中为粉丝塞满福利而闻名。巫师 3：狂猎 和 赛博朋克2077：往日之影 的标准版都附带了通常在更高价版本中才能见到的奖励，包括贴纸、地图、开发者的信、明信片等。当索尼——以及潜在的其他游戏实体——在 2028 年停止支持实体版时，这一切都将消失。
好吧，至少对于大多数游戏来说，这些都会消失。但对于 CD Projekt Red 来说，他们不会轻易放弃。虽然 巫师4 可能没有光盘，但团队仍希望确保其尚未定期的发布与前作一样特别。这就是为什么 巫师4 会以某种形式“拥有一个盒子”。
“但我们非常支持让人们接触到有形的收藏品，”Nowakowski 补充道，“我们自己也是极客，我们喜欢这些。我们一直支持这一点。所以，无论情况如何，我们肯定会有一个盒子。我们会有一个装有一些实体周边的盒子，一些你会想要打开并享受的东西。但实际上，我们对这里的情况没有影响力。”
目前，巫师4 还没有发布日期。在 CD Projekt Red 潜心开发以希里为主角的 Witcher 3 续作时，你可以看到团队如何通过官方复刻版和 Songs of the Past 扩张包为这款 2015 年的热门作品注入新活力。你还可以关注零售商和游戏行业对索尼近期决定的抨击。

items.title: 雷德利·斯科特称 Alien: Romulus “还行”，他将回归该系列，因为其“需要一些帮助”

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260830/bHKkpvbubhossEr.png
导演 Ridley Scott 表示 Alien: Romulus “还可以”，因此他将回归 Alien 系列，因为该系列“需要一些帮助”。
这位执导过 银翼杀手9732 和原版 Alien 以及新上映的《狗星》（The Dog Stars）的导演，在接受法国媒体 AlloCiné（通过 Deadline）采访时，表达了他对这一科幻系列走向的看法。在对话中，Scott 再次确认他已经“重新加入”了这个让他成名的 IP。
原因何在？他认为 Alien: Romulus 本可以做得更好。
“我正在重写下一部 Alien 电影，”Scott 解释道。“实际上，我突然回归并参与了进来。刚刚上映的那部（2024 年的 Alien: Romulus ）还可以。我认为它需要一些帮助。所以，我回来了。”
Alien: Romulus 作为 Alien 宇宙的一次软重启，将 Rain（Cailee Spaeny 饰）、合成人 Andy（David Jonsson 饰）和 Kay（Isabela Merced 饰）等新角色置入了一个充斥着异形、抱脸虫以及……其他生物的故事中。该片总体评价良好，烂番茄网站显示影评人得分为 80%，观众得分为 85%。
然而，对于 Scott 的品味来说，这似乎还不够。这很奇怪，因为该片导演 Fede Álvarez 曾表示，Scott 在看完早期剪辑版后告诉他这“太棒了”。
值得注意的是，Scott 确实将所指的项目称为“刚刚上映的那部”。他指的也有可能是 2025 年的电视剧 Alien: Earth ，但他在提到电影后发表了这一言论，这表明是 Alien: Romulus 让他想要再次参与。作为参考， Alien: Earth 也获得了积极的反响，影评人得分为 94%，观众得分为 65%。
无论如何，Scott 希望能更多地亲力亲为。他最近确认正在努力延续他从 2012 年的 Prometheus 和 2017 年的 Alien: Covenant 开始的三部曲，并计划推出一部由 Michael Fassbender 饰演的大卫（David）主演的新电影。计划是让这个角色在探讨人工智能（AI）话题的同时，“为自己创造一个勇敢的新世界”。他在新采访中透露了更多想法。
“我已经为下一部 Alien 构思好了蓝图，”他继续说道。“我们拍了 Prometheus 和 Alien: Covenant ，所以我将从 Alien: Covenant 结束的地方继续。大卫现在认为自己是奥兹曼迪亚斯（Ozymandias），他正在[在头旁绕着手指]。”
“我喜欢人工智能失控这一设定。如果我们发展人工智能，等到我们发现它失控的那一刻就太晚了。它可以像那样关闭世界上所有的数字设备。那将是一片混乱。这种事情才真正可怕。”
Scott 目前正鼓励观众观看昨天（2026 年 8 月 28 日）上映的《狗星》（The Dog Stars）。该片改编自同名末世小说，由 Jacob Elordi、Margaret Qualley 和 Josh Brolin 主演。然而，他提议的 Alien 三部曲完结篇何时首映仍是一个谜。
大卫将会回归，但 Rain 和 Andy 的未来仍不明朗。2024 年 11 月，官方宣布一部真正的 Alien: Romulus 续集正在筹备中。尽管当时有消息称 Álvarez 正在洽谈回归执导，且 Scott 也确认会参与其中，但去年 9 月的报道称 Álvarez 将仅以制片人的身份参与。

items.title: 《谎上生枝 Card Game》评测

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260830/WevfiBbubhlewcE.jpg
如果你在 2010 年代中期参加过派对，很有可能在那些聚会中玩过 Jackbox Games 团队推出的派对游戏 谎上生枝。自 2014 年首作发布以来的 12 年间，这款数字派对游戏已经推出了多个版本。现在，Jackbox Games 正在摆脱线缆束缚，将这款支柱级派对游戏带到桌面，为你的桌游之夜推出卡牌版。

这款全新的卡牌游戏继承了数字版中所有成功的欺诈规则。与其它版本一样，在 谎上生枝 中，其中一名玩家将担任“揭示者”，抽取一张卡牌并大声朗读一段带有空格的提示，由其他玩家写下一个合理的选项来填补空缺。然而，抽到提示的人知道正确答案，并会将其写下作为正确选项加入其中。所有玩家提交答案后进行洗牌，随后进入投票阶段，你将为你认为正确的答案投票。根据你是否猜对以及是否有其他人投票给你的答案来获取积分。在你们决定的轮数结束时（默认为六轮），积分最高的人获胜。
游戏盒的大小约为标准精装书，内部包含单面规则说明书（另一面是 杰克盒子派对4 的广告）、纸板投票/积分标记（但奇怪的是没有装它们的袋子）、六支带有写字板的干擦记号笔，以及 300 张带有提示的卡牌。提示本身涵盖了广泛的主题，从询问用吹风机做鸭子的厨师，到日本限定口味的百事可乐。大量的卡牌意味着在出现重复之前，你可以进行相当多场游戏，这非常棒。

与数字版一样，谎上生枝 Card Game 非常适合不断推出扩展包。了解 Jackbox 的人应该能想到，用不了多久我们就会看到额外的提示卡包、不同主题的提示，以及额外的记号笔和写字板。只要你有书写工具和记录积分的东西，其实没有任何理由限制玩家人数的增加。
谎上生枝 是我最喜欢的纯派对游戏之一。它是那种连爷爷奶奶都能参与其中并度过愉快时光的游戏。
谎上生枝 的一切都相当成功地转化为实体游戏，但有一个小例外——写答案的部分。它能玩吗？当然可以。问题在于，考虑到揭示者知道答案，除非你的团队成员笔迹非常相似，或者至少写方块字的方式很像（游戏建议使用这种方式），否则用不了多久你可能就会开始识别出玩家的笔迹。尤其是在玩家人数较少的情况下，我就遇到了这种情况。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260830/FftRzgbubhlexwc.jpg
我琢磨出了一点“村规”魔法：让揭示者收集所有提交的答案，然后在一张单独的纸上抄写所有答案，最后由小组对该列表进行投票。这确实增加了一个步骤和一点时间，但这确实能让投票与答案本身挂钩，而不是让每个人都假装自己是法庭文件鉴定专家（我查了一下，FDE 会为法庭查看并对比笔迹和签名——这也可能是某张卡牌上的问题）。

无论你怎么玩，谎上生枝 都是我最喜欢的纯派对游戏之一。它是那种连爷爷奶奶都能参与其中并度过愉快时光的游戏。我一直很欣赏 谎上生枝 对玩家提出的要求更高一点，它需要你更聪明、更有创意，而不是过度依赖“谁的回答最搞笑”来得分。我发现 Cards Against Humanity 和其他同类游戏往往会演变成这种局面。这个实体版的 谎上生枝 是对这款已经在派对上证明过自己实力的游戏的忠实改编，我预见自己会经常把它拿出来玩。

items.title: 我们试玩了 腐烂国度2 3：尽管 Xbox 遭遇动荡，但游戏表现依然出色。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260830/PVXOxVbubhhycCs.png

对于 Xbox 旗下的开发团队来说，这是一个动荡的时期，包括正处于“Xbox 重启”中所有权变更过程的 Undead Labs。这让我们对即将推出的丧尸生存游戏 腐烂国度2 3 的现状以及它是否能面世产生了无数疑问。不过，我在 2026 年科隆游戏展上体验了这款游戏，我很高兴地报告，我所看到的并亲手操作的这段 30 分钟简短演示展现了巨大的潜力。即使作为一个早期的 Alpha 版本，改进后的射击体验和动作移动给我留下了深刻印象，总体感觉这是一款在继承系列基础的同时，足以匹配当前世代水平的 腐烂国度2。
本作依然非常强调社区管理和基地建设，这两方面都以一些显著的方式进行了扩展。据我所观察，设施和建筑不一定遵循线性的升级路径，而是可以通过分支升级专注于特定功能。同样重要的是你将哪些角色分配到哪些设施——例如，那些拥有适合医疗领域特长或特质的角色可以提高其他幸存者的恢复速度。

我更详细地观察到了更深层的特质系统，其中每个程序生成的角色都有自己的一套可以进化的特长和怪癖。这类系统是 腐烂国度2 2 的核心部分，而现在它们似乎产生了更大的影响。一名幸存者拥有“洗澡时间长”的特质，因此会消耗更多的水资源来维持定居点。但他同时也擅长近战，所以当你想要在野外使用他时，他的洗澡习惯或许是值得的折中方案。另一个角色的特质显示她接受过狙击训练，在使用远程枪械和爆头时能提供额外伤害，但她更容易受伤——而且由于有了更细致的受伤系统，可以计算身体特定部位的损伤并施加某些功能的减益效果（例如武器精准度或移动速度），这比之前的游戏更需要你纳入考量。
当你管理超过 30 个角色时，在决定派谁去野外对抗丧尸以及派谁留在基地时，考虑这些特质会产生非常有趣的动态变化。我希望这些特质在长期游戏中的影响力能像我在简短试玩中感受到的那样显著。
更流畅、更有打击感的射击体验让每一刻的战斗感觉都比前作好得多。
但 腐烂国度2 一直以来同样关乎抵御丧尸潮，而在 腐烂国度2 3 中，情况有所不同。大型开放世界由许多城镇、设施和常规兴趣点组成，当你打开地图时，你会看到感染网络遍布全球并延伸到相邻城镇。受感染的定居点和瘟疫巢穴是你为了切断蔓延而需要打击的热点地区，这些地方会引发激烈的战斗。
在这些地点总会有一个感染核心，有时埋在设施下方或汽车修理店的车库里，有些可能是更复杂的地下城风格区域。但似乎无论地点在哪里，你都需要找到分布在各处的四个弱点才能摧毁它。在此过程中你还要抵御大量丧尸，一旦你打开了感染核心，规模更大的丧尸潮就会向你袭来。当你把剩下的子弹全部倾泻进核心，而浮肿者和巨无霸在丧尸浪潮中提供支援时，场面绝对是一片混乱，但一旦核心被摧毁，剩下的丧尸就会死掉。

这听起来很简单，但对我来说，更流畅、更有打击感的射击体验让每一刻的战斗感觉都比前作好得多。我使用带有鼓形弹匣的 AK-47 屠杀丧尸群，以及使用消音手枪进行一枪爆头，这些都显而易见，而且这还只是皮毛——我还看到你可以如何引诱丧尸群进入易燃的漏油区，或者更有效地使用潜行在局面失控前解决掉几个丧尸。你可以通过奔跑滑铲撞倒较弱的丧尸，并执行处决动作，让标准的近战球棒挥舞变得更有趣。如前所述，当控制具有适合这些玩法的技能和特质的幸存者时，这些玩法可以得到进一步加强。总的来说，腐烂国度2 3 玩起来像是一款正经的第三人称射击游戏，这与我们玩该系列所追求的管理模拟形成了鲜明的对比。
至少从这个早期版本来看，腐烂国度2 3 的主要核心似乎是通过清除感染点并防止其卷土重来，实现全地图范围的领土控制。随着时间的推移，感染会重新出现，对已建立定居点的围攻也会构成持续威胁，这是生存游戏的权衡艺术，也是该系列所熟悉的。因此，在收集食物、水和其他实用工具以维持幸存者生存的过程中，后台运行的模拟系统会让你时刻保持警惕。
当然，腐烂国度2 3 中有随时加入/退出的合作多人模式，且对会话内的玩家如何探索开放世界没有限制。Undead Labs 的团队还提到了一种动态难度系统，确保你不会轻而易举地横扫丧尸；如果你反复碰壁，它也可能会放慢节奏。随着开发的继续，这些问题肯定会得到解决，我所玩的早期 Alpha 版本中略显粗糙的技术表现也是如此。
更广泛地说，我希望这种通过战斗和定居点管理模拟进行的领土控制动态，在投入大量时间时能保持我的兴趣，就像我对待 腐烂国度2 2 那样。Undead Labs 花了很长时间才让前作达到一个良好的状态，现在它已经是一个相当成熟的整体了，也许这一作从一开始就能表现得更强。
团队坚持在 2026 年底进行封闭测试，并计划于 2027 年在 Xbox Series X|S、PlayStation 5 和 PC（通过 Steam）上正式发布。我们在 2026 年科隆游戏展上有大量的实机预览，所以请务必查看我们对 神鬼寓言4 的战斗、战争机器：事变日 的战役以及 Metro 2039 的初步印象。

items.title: GTA 6 Will Have No Microtransactions or Generative AI at Launch, Rockstar Says
items.summary: Rockstar Games has said Grand Theft Auto 6 will have no microtransactions or generative AI when it launches in

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/29/gta-6-microtransactions-ai-1788041234368.png
Rockstar Games has said Grand Theft Auto 6 will have no microtransactions or generative AI when it launches in November.

The studio behind GTA 6 confirmed this year's monumental open-world game will dodge two potentially controversial practices during a conversation with Kinda Funny Games earlier this week. It means launch should be free of backlash (at least when it comes to these two particular topics) when it arrives in a few months.

Kinda Funny's Andy Cortez said he asked Rockstar if players will be able to use real-world money to purchase things in-game during a preview event that preceded the GTA 6: Extended Look. He went on, saying, "no monetizations in this game."
The site's Greg Miller immediately followed that topic, saying he asked Rockstar "point-blank" if there is generative AI in GTA 6. The team told him that there is "no AI" used in the game.

From Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 to Arc Raiders , generative AI has proven time and time again to be an especially troublesome element for developers to include in their games. The millions of gamers who have waited 13 years for the next Grand Theft Auto might be pleased to hear similar claims won't mar its mid-November release date. The issue of microtransactions, however, does come with a few things worth noting.

Rockstar says GTA 6 will not feature the kind of monetization strategies that allow players to purchase content with real-world cash. That might arrive as good news for an entirely single-player release, but it's also yet another reminder that it doesn't look like the team has any intention of sharing any updates on a new iteration of Grand Theft Auto Online any time soon.

Meanwhile, while Rockstar has made it clear that, while there will be no monetization strategies like microtransactions in a traditional sense, there will be content gated off for some players in the form of its Ultimate Edition . Priced at $99.99 – a $20 increase from the $79.99 standard edition – this version of the game grants access to a host of exclusive content, including cosmetic packs, cars, guns, and even some shops, such as the Electric Fang tattoo parlor and Stock 305 clothing store. An official support page confirmed standard edition owners will be able to purchase an Ultimate Edition upgrade separately.
"Ultimate Edition bonuses are threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia's story, with new items uncovered behind each chapter," the page added.

Other than that, it sounds like players shouldn't expect any other microtransaction tactics – or generative AI – when GTA 6 launches for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19, 2026. There will surely be plenty more to show off ahead of its release date, but until then, you can check out IGN's exclusive preview and interview . You can also catch up on every licensed song revealed during the extended look , the GTA Online character who's making a comeback , and everything else Rockstar had to share during its big gameplay debut .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

items.title: A native port of Donkey Kong 64 is finally playable on PC thanks to a team of programmers who boast that 'no generative AI [was] used at any point in the process'
items.summary: The unofficial native port of the classic Nintendo platformer runs on modern hardware.

content.v: A native PC port of Nintendo's 1999 platformer Donkey Kong 64 is finally here, and the team that pulled it off is proud to say that they used zero generative AI tools in the process.
DK64 Rekongpiled , a recompilation or translation of the game's code for modern hardware (as opposed to emulation), dropped today. All you need is an original Donkey Kong 64 ROM to get it running.
In a post on Bluesky (and also in the trailer ), contributor 2dos wrote that "no generative AI [was] used at any point in the process."

Everything in the original game is still there, including its old fuzzy 3D graphics, bouncy soundtrack, and the rest of the things that made Donkey Kong 64 an innovative and sometimes maddening game. It all runs at high resolutions and high framerates like any other modern PC game. You can even play with a mouse now, too.

The port is here just two months after a group of programmers decided to take the project on after seeing another group heavily use AI vibe code in the process. At the time, contributor 2dos wrote in the N64 Recomp Discord server that the competing project's use of AI would "make it progressively harder to manage as time goes on."

"Our DK64 recompilation project is backed by folks who have worked on and tinkered with the backend of the DK64 code for well over a decade, and do not rely on vibe coding to make code changes," they wrote.

Piles of ports using generative AI programming tools like Claude have shown up in emulation and hacking communities a lot in the last few years because it allows programmers to put them together in a fraction of the time. Experienced programmers, like the ones working on DK64 Rekongpiled, see far too many problems with the bugs and other problems vibe coding creates.

Instead, they prefer to do it as cleanly as possible using their own skills from messing with the game's code. Some of the same people who worked on the port previously worked on the DK64 Randomizer .

The release trailer for DK64 Rekongpiled features a goofy but exceptionally charming little scene where the villain King K. Rool—voiced by 2dos, of course—realizes his plan to keep people from playing the classic game on PC has been foiled by some pesky programmers. His henchman, also voiced by 2dos, can't believe they got it to run in 4K at 200 frames per second and ditches his boss to go play it himself.
Generative AI couldn't make anything as convincing as that, if you ask me.

items.summary: 作者：柏亚舟 2026年8月的科隆游戏展（Gamescom）现场，我们再次见到了《英灵神殿》的开发团队。 这款生存建造游戏在2021年2月以抢先体验（Early Access）形式登陆Steam并广受好评（目前Steam

content.v: 作者：柏亚舟
2026年8月的科隆游戏展（Gamescom）现场，我们再次见到了《英灵神殿》的开发团队。
这款生存建造游戏在2021年2月以抢先体验（Early Access）形式登陆Steam并广受好评（目前Steam整体和简中均特别好评），销量也突破了500万——随着迷雾之地、灰烬之地等区域的陆续更新，这个由瑞典团队 Iron Gate 主导的独立游戏，不知不觉间已经走过了七年的开发历程。
而现在，《英灵神殿》将在9月9日迎来1.0 版本的更新。据悉，1.0 版本不仅将补全游戏地图上的最后一块极寒区域“深北之地（Deep North）”，带来全新的冰上生存机制与室内 Boss 战，还将为整个维京神话故事提供一个具有实质意义的结局。
在本次展会期间，我们与开发团队进行了一次简要的专访。
Q：机核网
A：不作严格区分的多位受访人，包括 Robin Eyre, Art Director Sara Uvalic, Lead Producer Lisa Kolfjord, Senior Artist Andreas Tomasson, QA Manager & Lead Designer
https://image.gcores.com/419a36ec4d8bf8fc33daf26d26d9eb98-2219-1248.png
以下为本次采访实录：
Q：对于即将到来的 1.0 版本，团队现在的感受如何？
A： 团队现在非常开心！我们非常兴奋能让大家看到我们做了这么久的心血结晶。但同时甚至有一点伤感，因为这也意味着一个时代的结束，一种收尾。不过总体来说，我们非常开心和兴奋。
现在，我们会在《英灵神殿》中拥有一段开场动画，也有一段结尾动画。这意味着整个《英灵神殿》的故事有了一个完整的结局。同时，我们这些年也是在《英灵神殿》的陪伴下成长起来的，现在就像是看着自己的孩子走向世界，1.0 版本就是那个节点。
Q：新的“深北之地（Deep North）”也是那种寒冷刺骨的感觉，能说说它和之前“凛冽雪山（Mountains）”的区别吗？
A： 最大的区别在于，深北之地是无法直接进行建筑的。你必须使用铲子先清理积雪，清出空地后才能开始建造。而且到了晚上如果下雪，积雪还会重新覆盖，所以你必须经常去清理——当然，这可能是我们瑞典人的日常工作（笑）。我们确实有受到生活的启发。
另一个难点在于，深北之地会有大面积非常滑的冰盖。但在生物环境上，深北之地要更接地气一些，主要会遇到驼鹿（Moose）和海豹，它们是那里最大的生物。
Q：（在问答期间，开发团队也同时在演示游戏）我看到你们加入了一个巨大的巨魔（Troll），那是最新的 Boss 吗？
A： 哦，那边那个！那其实不是 Boss，那就是一个……你可以把它当成一个小怪，甚至可以说连 Boss 都算不上—— 没错，就是个普通怪物（笑）。
https://image.gcores.com/db2019d6f826ba7e981b263535856645-2219-1248.png
Q：当玩家在深北之地尝试建立终极基地时，还会面临怎样的环境挑战？
A： 就像我刚才提到的，因为那里非常非常冷，你需要长时间穿着保暖衣物。但我们也加入了很多新的建筑组件，比如你可以用冰块等材料进行建造，甚至可以借此强制敌人去在冰面上滑倒。
此外，我们重做了整个建筑菜单系统。因为这是一个全新的系统，所以有了“最近使用”和“最喜欢”的分类，你可以根据不同的材料进行筛选，非常方便。
Q：人和怪物都会滑吗？
A：是的，这会很有趣不是么？
Q：关于深北之地的海洋探索，有什么危险在等着玩家吗？
A： 准备好迎接深北之地的深水区吧。我们在做灰烬之地（Ashlands）的时候，那里的水域是沸腾、极其炎热的，你根本无法在里面游泳，而且水下还有伤害极高的海蛇。
但在深北之地，水面一开始会非常平静。当你到达那里时，你唯一需要考虑的就是那些滑溜溜的冰块。你没法把船一直开到陆地上，这更像是一场北极探险，你必须在冰面上滑行才能登陆，然后在那里提取你需要的资源。
Q：1.0 版本当然会是一个重要的节点，所以我很期待它的最终 Boss 战会有怎样史诗级的体验？
A： 最终 Boss 战会非常酷！ 虽然我们不能剧透太多关于 Boss 的细节，但可以告诉你，那是一场非常史诗级的战斗，包含了很多炫酷的特效和音效，看起来非常棒，难度也很高。
这也是我们第一次尝试这种类型的 Boss 战，而且这场战斗是在室内进行的！你会在通关后获得非常丰厚的奖励。
https://image.gcores.com/0b0e523c00f6bc039ebfed82120f8eb5-2219-1248.png
Q：游戏发售至今，社区玩家有哪些创意或者反馈让你们感到特别惊喜？
A： 玩家们做了很多让我们惊叹的事情，从各种建筑到用我们的系统创造出的奇观，比如《星球大战》里的千年隼，还有大型的中世纪城堡、村庄、城市摩天大楼。
他们还会试图打破世界的规则，想尽办法去那些不该去的地方。比如天上那棵世界之树（Yggdrasil）的树枝，就有玩家真的爬了上去！
还有一个例子，我们在灰烬之地加入了一个弹射器，玩家甚至用羽毛披风把自己当成炮弹弹射出去，飞越整个世界。这太棒了，看着非常欢乐，虽然我们可以阻止这种行为，但我们不想这么做，因为这太有趣了！我们还在迷雾之地（Mistlands）加入了一个抓钩，这应该也会让玩家们去到一些“不该去”的地方。
Q：确实，这个游戏的社区玩家总在试图“打破规则”。作为一个中国玩家，我观察到中国社区的玩家在“尝试打破游戏”这方面似乎做得最极致。
A： 你们确实非常擅长这个（笑）。老实说，我们觉得玩家这么做非常有趣，这是一件很棒的事。游戏的初衷就是为了寻找乐趣，如果你们能通过做一些特别的事情、打破游戏的框架来获得乐趣，我认为这是完全被允许的。这就是意义所在——在每一场游戏里寻找乐子！
https://image.gcores.com/eb8434bfe8df7b9aa3118f51878ef230-1000-264.jpg

items.title: EA Motive's Iron Man Game Reveal 'Didn't Go as Planned,' But the Leak Has Marvel Fans More Excited Than Ever
items.summary: EA Motive Studio's Iron Man game suffered an unexpected leak, but it may have resulted in Marvel fans being mo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/29/iron-man-game-leak-fans-excited-1788034487836.png
EA Motive Studio's Iron Man game suffered an unexpected leak, but it may have resulted in Marvel fans being more excited about it than ever.

Leaks in the gaming world are generally perceived as bad. Just look at Grand Theft Auto 6, a game that suffered a waterfall of leaks so significant that it sent Rockstar scrambling to pick up the pieces . When a trailer for Motive's Iron Man game was hit with a leak earlier this week, however, EA chose to handle its unexpected gameplay reveal a little differently.

Unlike GTA 6, Iron Man only had to deal with a controlled (and early-in-development) peek behind the curtain, leaving fans to comb through every second of footage for highlights. Seeing Tony Stark zipping around skyscrapers and dodging enemies on S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarriers is far and away the most we've seen so far, but considering the damage had already been done, EA decided to have a bit of fun with it. Just hours after clips began to circulate on social media, EA erected a new, official X/Twitter account and shared a tongue-in-cheek message. The result? Millions of views and hundreds of thousands of reactions.
Well, that didn't go as planned. But now you know, and we've got a lot more to show you. See you when we’re ready. pic.twitter.com/tU4TtUoZYZ

"Well, that didn't go as planned," EA's post, which boasts 14.8 million views and 198K likes at the time of this story's publication, said. "But now you know, and we've got a lot more to show you. See you when we're ready."

There had been some concern EA had quietly shelved its Iron Man game when Motive was brought in to help the Battlefield 6 team in 2024 . We're just a few weeks shy of four years since its initial announcement , and updates have been few and far between in the time since.

A leak of this magnitude showing an in-development game could have been seen as a net-negative – and for EA, maybe it still is. For everyone else who has waited years to see what a standalone Iron Man game could look, play, and sound like, it couldn't have come at a better time.
Motive when they saw that their Iron Man Trailer leaked but everyone loves it and is gassing them up pic.twitter.com/ANRO6NtGOj
Yeah the trailer leaked so what your honour? We’re cooking straight fire and now everyone knows that https://t.co/AzBeV67l8B pic.twitter.com/21ai3hBZog
Using the leak to gas yourselves up instead of ignoring it??? https://t.co/3sMEbQoGJr pic.twitter.com/mHk5rf9tzF
How Motive feels after successfully using gaming leaks as free marketing https://t.co/Iy9jfBekuJ pic.twitter.com/1qXPikFJ6l
"CRYING," one popular reply said . "GOATED RESPONSE. LET'S GOOOOOO."
"Very on brand for Iron Man to get hacked and aura farm because of it," another fan said .
"See this is how you handle a leak," another added . "Embrace it and keep cooking. Not burying your head in the sand."

There is an ocean of positive responses to this one post, which dropped almost out of nowhere in the middle of a Friday. Many also stick with the theme, saying that acknowledging the leak in this way feels reminiscent of the kind of move Tony Stark would pull.

It's been so long since we last heard from the next project from the Dead Space remake and Star Wars: Squadrons developer that you don't have to look too hard to find responses from those who had no idea a standalone Iron Man experience was even in development. For them, this might as well be a brand-new game announcement for one of the most popular Marvel superheroes in existence.
we’re really getting a whole iron man solo game pic.twitter.com/TVZwOQiSNX
IT DIDNT GET CANCELED pic.twitter.com/SqYvGBHBIi

Although it's unclear when exactly the leaked footage was captured or how much longer it will be before an official launch, fans online seem to be quite happy with how EA and Motive's Iron Man game is shaping up. Some of the footage suggested things like armor customization and wrist-mounted laser attacks will be part of the experience. A few blink-and-you'll-miss-it moments also teased Marvel comics characters like James Rhodes/War Machine and Pepper Pots could show up throughout what seems to be a globe-trotting adventure, too.
"You know what's funny," another fan online said , "I feel like this leak might have helped them because all I'm seeing is overwhelmingly positive responses to it."
"Their response was great and the footage looked fire," another said . "Can't help but root for them."

Although the leak did turn out to be real, there's a good chance some or even all of what we've seen could be cut before the final build. EA Motive's Iron Man game currently has no release date, nor does it have a list of launch platforms. While we won't share that leaked footage here, we can confirm that clips are absolutely still out there, and you probably won't have to look too hard to find them.
For more, you can see how Iron Man is coming back to theaters with the Avengers: Endgame re-release . You can also read about Avalanche Studios' canceled Iron Man game, which also recently leaked .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

items.title: Elden Ring players are hard at work putting the new Tarnished Edition DLC's gear to the test
items.summary: Some poor bosses are getting "the Matador treatment".

content.v: Hand Elden Ring players a handful of new armor sets and weapons and they'll spend the next week or more experimenting and crunching the numbers to find out how they stack up against everything else in the legendary action RPG.
That is all that's been happening in the last few days since FromSoftware dropped the Tarnished Edition, a $5 DLC pack with new starting classes, armor sets, and horse armor .

It took a little while for people to figure out where to find everything added in the DLC. FromSoft did what FromSoft does and snuck them into places you wouldn't expect. But now that everyone feels like they've found it all, including some minor additions that weren't announced, the testing has begun.

By far the most popular new weapon is a greatsword you can steal from a new NPC who can show up for a duel. Leontiel's Greatsword is a direct reference to a character from Dark Souls 2 and comes with a powerful new move that mimics real life bullfighters, or matadors. When you use it, your character holds out a red cloth before stepping around your target and thrusting the sword into their back. It's easily one of the slickest animations in the game and, unsurprisingly, has players eager to see how it fairs against bosses.

Reddit user SaxSlaveGael put it to work on the one bull-like boss in the game, titling their post, "There's Only One Boss that truly deserves the Matador Treatment". When used on old Gaius in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC, the sword's Muleta skill works just like the real taunt that matadors do with the instrument it's named after. Gaius' boar was not ready for the feint and follow-up backstab. Is it the most efficient way to defeat the boss? Nope. Is it the sickest way to defeat the boss? Absolutely.

Another user, Ilamahradeys , took the sword for a spin against the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast at the center of a crater in Mt. Gelmir. Their character must've been pretty over-leveled because one jab with the sword knocked off almost the entire health bar, instantly staggering the rock-like creature. I won't lie: Watching a boss as resilient and annoying as the Fallingstar Beast get completely dunked on, with style, no less, was one of the most satisfying things I've seen all week.

You'd think that in a game as challenging as Elden Ring players would only ever use armor for practical reasons. But, as is tradition with these games, "fashion souls" is more important to some people than pure defense. And those players are in love with the shiny new chestpiece from the Idus starting class. It's a svelte, polished chestplate that blends with a lot of other sets in the game. One player has it on to cosplay Casca from Berserk , while another is too distracted by the buff it seems to give to your greatest asset .

Elden Ring also attracts the tryhards who need to know how viable all the new stuff is for their 90th playthrough. There's a Reddit user who blasted through the game as the new heavy armor class. They say it's a particularly sturdy class that takes some time to fully come into its own. It's boosted vigor (health) and strength stats—two things melee-focused characters tend to stack—help it shine in the mid-to-late game when the nastiest bosses start showing up.

All of this has me excited to start up a new Elden Ring playthrough myself. The Tarnished Edition isn't a game-changing DLC by any means, but it has just enough new toys to play with to make me want to get in there and mess around. We don't always get a neat little package like this for only $5 and it's probably just enough to keep me busy until the flood of September games begins.

The Witcher 4 will still "have a box" for physical game collectors even after Sony stops supporting discs in 2028, CD Projekt Red has confirmed.

Studio joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski confirmed the Cyberpunk 2077 studio still plans to release a physical edition during an interview with The Game Business . He admitted CD Projekt Red has no control when it comes to Sony's plans to halt production for physical PlayStation discs, but they do still have the power to make The Witcher 4 feel special for collectors.

"We don’t know what’s going to be the case," he said. "We know what PlayStation has announced. And we have no influence on the policies of the first parties. The discs for the first parties, including PlayStation, have to be manufactured in their own factories. So, if they stop manufacturing indeed by 2028, then yes [we won’t have a disc]."

Sony infamously announced plans to end production for physical PlayStation games in July , promising the move would take effect starting January 2028. It was a brutal blow to those who have spent decades collecting discs for their favorite games, but it will be especially painful as games previously expected to receive physical support launch without a disc.

The Witcher 4 became one of those titles when CD Projekt Red suggested it was aiming for a 2028 release date . The studio is known for packing its physical releases full of goodies for fans, too. Both standard editions for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and Cyberpunk 2077 came with the kind of bonuses you'd expect in a pricier release, including stickers, a map, a letter from the developers, postcards, and more. When Sony – and, potentially, other gaming entities – cease support for physical releases in 2028, that goes away.

Well, at least for most releases, it goes away. For CD Projekt Red, they aren't going down without a fight. While there may not be a disc for The Witcher 4, the team still wants to ensure its undated launch is just as special as the last. That's why, in some form, The Witcher 4 will "have a box."

"But we’re big fans of people having access to tangible collectible things," Nowakowski added. "We’re nerds ourselves, and we like that. We always supported that. So, whatever is the case, we’re going to be for sure having a box. We’re going to have a box that’s going to have some feelies in it. Something you’re going to be wanting to open up and enjoy. But we have no influence actually on what’s the case here."

For now, The Witcher 4 has no release date. As CD Projekt Red tinkers away at its Ciri-led Witcher 3 follow-up, you can see how the team is revitalizing its 2015 hit with an official remaster and the Songs of the Past expansion. You can also check out how both retailers and the gaming industry have lashed out at Sony over its recent decision.

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

items.title: Valve assures Deadlock players hungry for its next big update that it will notify them, 'or order a ton of pizza', when it's ready
items.summary: Yoshi said to expect the new big update by the end of September.

content.v: I don't envy Deadlock players who are dying to see the hybrid MOBA-shooter continue to grow in its pseudo-early access state. Valve is notoriously elusive when it comes to communication and has never made any promises to update it on a regular schedule.

This is the kind of uncertainty that drives Deadlock players to salivate over any new rumor or post by the developer-run Discord and forum account known as Yoshi. It's also what drives them to keep watch over the pizzerias near Valve's Seattle offices for spikes in visitors in the hopes that developers are lining up for grub as they finish the next major update.

This week, Deadlock players were hoping Valve would release its follow-up to the Old Gods, New Blood update , which added six new heroes to the game along with other major changes. Valve previously said a "large content update" was in the works alongside two other smaller updates to its ranked mode and items. But now that the ranked rework is out of the way, players were hoping to see another update before the end of the month.

According to a new post from Yoshi , the update is taking longer than expected. Yoshi doesn't specify if they're talking about the item update or the large content update—it almost implies they've been combined into one patch—but said it's going to have to wait until "late September."

"The delay is mainly due to the regular process of playtesting and iteration sometimes taking longer than expected, rather than a change in the scope of the update itself," they wrote. "We hope you will like the update when it comes out, and we'll make sure to give you a heads up (or order a ton of pizza) when things are a few days away or so."
Yoshi with less than ideal news on the patch: pic.twitter.com/syEtthtab5 August 28, 2026

Even though Valve has kept Deadlock an invite-only game since its debut, the last year of updates have gotten it to a place that feels like it could go fully public as an open beta. You never know with Valve, a studio that has spent years on projects only to quietly abandon them before. But the Old Gods, New Blood update was the first time it made a big deal of a new patch, creating an entire webpage dedicated to it and letting the community vote on the release order of the new heroes.
It was an unprecedented level of effort that seemed to suggest Deadlock had a relatively large amount of weight behind it for a Valve project. Since then, the updates have kept a steady pace.

Whether or not Yoshi's acknowledgement of the pizza thing is tongue-in-cheek, it does make it seem like the team behind Deadlock is aware that players desperately want more from the game and that it plans to deliver on that as fast as it can. I hope it also means Deadlock is closer than ever to opening the gates for everyone to try its sharply-designed mix of MOBA and hero shooter mechanics.

items.title: All the key details on HoYo's co-op monster slayer Nodusfall

content.v: Nodusfall may look like developer miHoYo has slapped an Elden Ring-colored paint job onto Monster Hunter, but there's some signature HoYo innovation to find in between all those beastly battles and dark fantasy landscapes in its reveal trailer.

While there aren't an awful lot of specifics about the game right now, I've scraped together every gameplay clip and interview available to help explain what HoYo's breakup with anime girls is all about. From betas, to gacha, to gameplay and story, here's everything we know about Nodusfall so far.
Nodusfall release date speculation
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZvTRQgApsSq669wkVSf6iF.jpg
Nodusfall release date details and speculation

Nodusfall doesn't have a solid release date yet—it doesn't even have a release year. That's typical for a HoYo game, though. It doesn't tend to announce release dates until a game's final round of beta testing is coming up.

Even though there's no release window HoYo's ever-reliable pattern of three open betas before release lets us predict that Nodusfall will launch sometime in 2028. Especially as its next game, Petit Planet, is out this winter, and Honkai: Nexus Anima seems set for a 2027 release, having just finished its second open beta.

The only thing that might throw a spanner in the works is that Nodusfall isn't your typical character/critter collector that HoYo is known for. So it might not be so typical when it comes to beta testing either.
Nodusfall beta and pre-registration

Speaking of betas, you can visit the official Nodusfall site and do a two-for-one combo by pre-registering and then answering a questionnaire for possible beta selection right after. The site mentions that this is for future betas, not for one ongoing right now. So you won't be fighting those Nodusfall bosses just yet no matter how furiously fast you refresh your inbox.
Nodusfall trailers

If you want a refresh on its gorgeous dark fantasy visuals and otherworldly boss designs that'd make Elden Ring and Diablo blush, here's the reveal trailer above. There's not much gameplay here, but what there is definitely throws up inevitable comparisons to co-op combat seen in the Monster Hunter series.
Nodusfall story and setting
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/myxEcLDGu2ZNVk7gNwLtmF.jpg

The story of Nodusfall unfolds across a dark fantasy "mythic continent" teeming with corrupted legendary creatures, whose designs take inspiration from both Eastern and Western mythology. Like manticores, dragons, and giant bears. You take on the role of a "Weaver," a being "enlightened by the divine" and entrusted with sacred missions to restore order to the continent corrupted by the "Dreadnodi". So basically, you're a big important badass with divine magic powers and chunky weapons whose mission is to blast scary monsters to get new gear save the world.

On your way to annihilating ethereal beasts and untold horrors, you'll journey through distinct regions with landscapes and cultures that take equal inspiration from various real-life cultures and mythologies, with more regions set to launch post-release. My fellow Genshin Impact players will be familiar with this formula.

Thanks to its reveal trailer, we know that some of Nodusfall's landscapes include golden hills, fiery skies, dreary moors, misty forests, dusty deserts, and gargantuan canyons. So far so Elden Ring, but it sounds like there's more variety in the works.

What I'm most interested in seeing is just how dark Nodusfall ends up being. The reveal trailer suggested a mature story, which isn't a first for HoYo—Genshin has dropped its fair share of dark lore and ran—but not shifting to a wisecrack or bonkers anime moment right after would be new.
Nodusfall gameplay

Breaking from the single-player teambuilding mold that HoYo is known for, Nodusfall is actually a free-to-play co-op action game that pits you and your squad against mythical creatures. Pick a character, build a loadout, and work with up to three other players to defeat difficult bosses and get the resources needed to unlock new skills and forge new weapons.
Why yes, it is eyebrow-raisingly similar to Monster Hunter, but there are some key differences. Such as:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2mpVcLf9KmbMNZYXEq8UkF.jpg

And although not expanded on, Nodusfall's official site claims that you can "switch roles and loadouts at will". Which presumably means you're not locked to playing just one character or build per account.

In practice, judging from hands-on impressions and what little gameplay there is right now, Nodusfall looks like it's actually a mix of Elden Ring, an MMO, and Monster Hunter—not just a Monster Hunter wannabe. Yeah, this may just sound like even more games that Nodusfall is riffing on, but if there's one thing I've learned about playing HoYo games over the years it's that you should never doubt its ability to innovate on the familiar and create one heck of a satisfying combat loop.
We played Nodusfall

PC Gamer's Fraser Brown played Nodusfall right after its reveal and was pretty impressed, even as a HoYo skeptic. "First of all: Nodusfall is not remotely a soulslike," Fraser says in his Nodusfall preview . "Monster Hunter is a closer relative. Solo adventurers and groups can select contracts, and then go out into the world to hunt down big beasties. These are lengthy, elaborate fights with multiple phases, taking place in spacious outdoor areas."

"I became rather fond of the clash mechanic, where you charge up a strong attack, and release it right as the monster is about to hit you, countering the attack. It helps that I looked stylish doing it, with my already massive sword growing, transforming into a magical, glowing WMD."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pWPUfoebFs7xRf6fpgUtfX.jpg
Is Nodusfall gacha?

There is no character gacha in Nodusfall , which means you'll never have to rely on luck (or piles of cash) to get new characters—they're all obtained by simply playing the story. No official line on if anything else will be linked to gacha systems, but HoYo has stated that cosmetic monetization is "an important avenue" that it'll be considering for Nodusfall.

So no, Nodusfall is not a gacha game in the traditional sense , but it may end up incorporating some RNG pulls elsewhere. Maybe for exclusive cosmetics similar to Where Winds Meet, or maybe even some special type of gear. Or maybe we'll get the biggest win of all and Nodusfall will be entirely gacha-free! (Please let me dream.)

items.title: The Long Dark will get new DLC again as studio shifts devs away from the sequel to survive an 'uncertain' industry: 'We have to adapt to this'
items.summary: Blackfrost's early access release won't make it this year after all.

content.v: Survival game The Long Dark was supposed to be over when its final story episode was released earlier this year . Developer Hinterland announced its sequel, Blackfrost , two years ago and planned to go the early access route with it just like the first game.

According to a new update from the studio, however, those plans have changed a little bit. While it continues to work on Blackfrost in the background, a small team of developers have been moved back onto The Long Dark to make new DLC for its survival mode. Hinterland hopes going back to the 9-year-old game will help it endure an "uncertain" industry.

"When we first announced Blackfrost, the sequel to The Long Dark, the game industry was in a very different place," it said. "In the short time since, entire business models have been thrown into chaos, the geopolitical situation has become extremely complicated, the picture of what the next generation of console hardware will be has become a lot less clear, and the amount of time and money players spend on new games has declined as everyone turns to the comfort and security of games they already know."

Over the next two years, the studio plans to continue updating the survival sandbox mode in the game with bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, new features, and new regions from the final story episode. It's also going to release new DLC, one of which will come out piecemeal like its previous Tales From The Far Territory expansion pass. The second DLC "will be… different from that," it said, withholding info because it's still early in development.

Hinterland assured everyone Blackfrost is still in the works but said that its early access launch has been pushed to next year. The studio remains independent despite having publishers reach out to help with the sequel. "We've not yet encountered a partner who we feel is truly motivated by what's best for Hinterland or for our players, so we'll continue to self-fund and self-publish the game."

Hinterland said it's considering raising the price of the standalone Survival Mode as well as the new DLCs to help offset the loss from people buying them on sale. "We’re also mindful that the economic reality faced by a ton of folks today is that prices are increasing everywhere and you probably can’t really afford for games to get more expensive as well," it said. "We’re really trying to find a good balance here." Given the flood of layoffs across the games industry in the last few years and the cost of hardware skyrocketing , I can see why an indie studio like Hinterland would go back to what works as people are forced to be more picky than ever about what they spend money on. It's already hard enough making a splash on the crowded pages of Steam when you release a new game. I just hope it works out and it can continue to make the sort of things it wants to without feeling anchored to its breakout release.

items.title: Modern gamers spoiled by Steam will never understand the joy of a MegaPak
items.summary: A requiem for the early days of budget PC gaming.

content.v: Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh, Ted, and Rick have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager .

It's easy to be cynical about the modern games industry, what with developers being laid off left and right and hardware prices skyrocketing thanks to AI datacentres gobbling up all the components. But it's also worth pointing out the positives too. For starters, games are more abundant than ever before. More games get released in a single day than most people could feasibly play in an entire year, and those games cover every genre and experience imaginable. If you can think of a game you want to play, it probably exists in some form. If it doesn't, someone is probably trying to make it.

As well as being omnipresent, games are cheaper than they've ever been too. This statement might seem spurious in the era of £70 games. But aside from the fact that, relative to inflation, games are technically cheaper than they were thirty years ago, it doesn't account for the endless stream of bundles and giveaways across all digital platforms. They're so frequent that, by the time you've finished playing your current game, there's a good chance you'll be able to grab what you want to play next on some form of discount.

In short, we're spoiled for choice in a way that's drastically different from how the gaming scene was thirty years ago, when games were significantly less numerous and generally less accessible financially. It's hard to estimate because everybody's experience varies. But I think, in 1996, if you were buying a new game every month, you would have been considered to be doing pretty well. For most people, new games would have been limited to Christmases and birthdays, and a lot of people would have experienced games through shareware demos or hooky copies burned onto a CD by your mate.

I don't want to turn this article into a Facebook post by your grandad, so let's stress that even if the number of game releases was far fewer, it didn't feel like that. Still, the idea of being able to hoover up a whole bunch of PC games for pennies was virtually unthinkable.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xMyxZh3evw4FgBhBtnpYrK.jpg

There was one big exception though—the MegaPak. The MegaPak was the closest thing we had to Humble Bundle (without the charity element), a big-box compilation of games that had typically been released one or two years prior. The MegPak was the production of Megamedia Corp, which has relatively little footprint online. But I can tell you that its handful of other publishing credentials include the Ukrainian Quake clone Chasm: The Rift .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ePfEGFZT576Mwxi8zVKqLV.jpg

The first Megapak was released in 1994, featuring eleven games. You can tell this because the box proudly displays the number 11 in massive yellow font, which I suppose indicates how novel the concept was. It has also led some database sites to label it as "Megapak 11", which was incredibly confusing for me when researching for this article because the Megapak line ended at number 10.

Nonetheless, it was probably right for Megapak to focus on the number of games for marketing purposes, because the quality of the titles in the pack is, shall we say, variable? The highlights of the first Megapak are Ultima spinoff World of Ultima: The Savage Empire, combat flight sim F-14 Tomcat, and Test Drive 3: The Passion—a title that makes it sound like a vehicular reimagining of Christ's crucifixion. Also included was Dinosaur Safari, an edu-tainment game that was halfway between an adventure game and Microsoft Encarta. I bring this up for no reason other than I played a ton of it on my dad's PC—Megapak notwithstanding.

This is a typical overview of the content of a Megapak, a lesser title from a big franchise, a bunch of fair to middling vehicle simulators, and a couple of oddball picks thrown in. As time went on, juicier games began to appear. Megapak 2 included Ocean's Jurassic Park, which people fondly remember today. Megapak 3, meanwhile, had TFX, a jet-fighting sim that was a cut above most combat sims of the era.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JcxTUU98X9EbfBhW7e9T3Q.jpg

The heyday of the Megapak came in 1996, when Megapak 5 arrived. Among the pinball game and pool simulators were several genuine PC gaming heavyweights. Most notable was Jagged Alliance, the mercenary turn-based tactics games which alongside X-COM helped formalise the genre. Also included was Apogee's Descent rival Terminal Velocity , and Looking Glass' Flight Unlimited, a well-regarded flight sim which has been somewhat forgotten in the wake of games like Thief and System Shock 2 .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/i4QMiiM8z7XDS7JT9t7D6.jpg

These weren't the best games that would eventually feature on a Megapak. Megapak 7 has Caesar 2 and Heroes of Might and Magic, while Megapak 8 treated players to SimCity 2000 and Mechwarrior II. But Megapak 5 was the best expression of what a Megapak was meant to be, a snapshot of PC gaming in the present moment.

Megapak 5 was also the first of them I personally owned, gifted as a Christmas present in 1997. The main thing I remember about it, outside of the games themselves, is the weight of the box. Each game came on its own CD in a paper sleeve, and if I remember rightly, the pack had a bespoke manual thick enough to kill a large insect or small rodent. You could feel the value of it in your hands.

The grab-bag nature of it was also part of the appeal. I was too young to have much foreknowledge of which games in the box were worth my time and which weren't, so there was an element of discovery in playing them. It was through Megapak 5 that I discovered Entomorph: Plague of the Darkfall , which was my introduction to roleplaying games and has been lodged in my head ever since.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/S4rMxADikLATLb4MMvHLGU.jpg

The Megapak era burned bright and faded quickly, with nine volumes released between 1994 and 1998. What happened to Megapak Corp afterwards isn't entirely clear. A tenth and final Megapak collection appeared in 2001. But it was published by Empire Interactive rather than Megamedia Corp. All the games featured on this Megapak were also Empire-published titles.

Clearly then, the Megapak license transitioned from Megamedia Corp to Empire in some fashion. Unfortunately, I couldn't find any information online to confirm this, and there seems to be no mention of the Megapak name or Megamedia Corp in Empire's published accounts.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hUpbi3g6GL9d7xBU8fNvag.jpg

Either way, there is a clear indication of why the Megapak line came to an end. In 2000, Empire launched Xplosiv, its own range of budget titles, which, alongside Sold Out, became one of the two main brands you'd find piling up in the bargain bin of UK game stores nationwide. Hence the likely scenarios are that Empire bought Megapak to kill the competition, opted not to continue with the series after a poor performance from Megapak 10, or entered into a publishing agreement with Megamedia Corp for Megapak 10 while spinning up its own budget range on the sly.

Whatever happened, the upshot was that the era of big-box PC compilations ended, and the era of lurid orange DVD cases began. I don't begrudge that—I had plenty of fun with those later budget lines too. Nor would I choose to go back to the Megapak era over our modern age of abundant, easily accessible games.

items.title: Fibbage纸牌游戏评论

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/fibbage-thumb-1787947104062.jpg
如果您在 2010 年代中期参加聚会，那么您很有可能至少在其中一些聚会中参加了由 Jackbox Games 背后的人员开发的聚会游戏“Fibbage”。自 2014 年第一款游戏发布以来，这款数字派对游戏在过去的 12 年里经历了多次迭代，现在 Jackbox Games 正在切断线缆，将这款主流派对游戏带到桌面上，推出适合您的棋盘游戏之夜的卡牌版本。

有助于制作这款数字虚张声势游戏的所有规则都已延续到这款新纸牌游戏中。与其他迭代一样，在《Fibbage》中，其中一名玩家将充当“揭秘者”，他将抽一张牌并大声朗读提示，其中一部分被空白，然后由其他玩家写下一个合理的选项来完成提示。然而，提出提示的人将会得到正确答案，并将其写下来并添加为正确答案。玩家们都会输入他们的答案，这些答案将被打乱，然后是一个投票期，你可以投票选出你认为正确的答案。从那里开始，根据您是否猜对以及其他人是否投票支持您的提交来获得积分，并且在您决定的无论多少轮（默认情况下为六轮）结束时得分最高的人获胜。
盒子的大小与标准精装书差不多，里面有单面纸（另一面是 Jackbox Party Pack 4 的广告）、纸板投票/积分代币（但奇怪的是没有袋子可以放进去）、六块带木板的干擦记号笔和 300 张带有提示的卡片。这些提示本身涵盖了一系列不拘一格的主题，从询问用吹风机烹饪鸭子的厨师到百事可乐的日本独有口味。令人印象深刻的卡牌数量意味着您将需要完成大量游戏才能开始多次重复，这很棒。
Fibbage Card Game，就像数字版本一样，已经成熟了，可以一次又一次地扩展，并且了解 Jackbox，我想用不了多久我们就会开始看到额外的提示卡包、不同主题的提示以及额外的标记和书写板。只要你有东西可以写，有东西可以记录分数，你就没有任何理由不能将玩家数量扩展到你想要的数量。
《Fibbage》的一切都相当成功地跳转到了实体游戏，只有一个小小的例外——写答案部分。有效吗？当然。问题是，考虑到揭露者知道答案，除非你们的小组有非常相似的笔迹，或者至少写了相似的方框字母（游戏建议你使用），否则不久你可能会开始识别玩家的笔迹。尤其是在玩家人数较少的游戏中。我遇到的一个情况。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/fibbage-2-1787946651985.jpg
我想出的一个自制魔法是，我让揭露者收集提交的内容，然后在另一张纸上抄下所有答案，然后小组对该列表进行投票。它确实增加了一个额外的步骤和更多的时间，但这确实设法使选票与答案挂钩，而不是每个人都假装自己是法医文件审查员（我查了一下；FDE 查看并比较法院的笔迹和签名 - 也可能是也可能不是其中一张卡片上的问题）。
不管你怎么玩，《Fibbage》都是我最喜欢的纯派对游戏之一。这是一款即使是老奶奶和爷爷也能玩得开心的游戏。我一直很欣赏《Fibbage》对玩家的要求更高，要求你更加聪明和有创造力，而不是过分依赖“谁的反应最有趣”来得分。我发现《反人类纸牌》和其他游戏往往会陷入这种结果。 Fibbage 的物理版本是对一款游戏的忠实改编，该游戏在派对上广受好评，我可以看到自己经常推出这款游戏。

items.title: 我希望 MMO 再次浪费我们的时间
items.summary: I've accomplished very little on a Star Wars Galaxies private server, and I wouldn't want it any other way.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PgGhmt5pTtxusaQQX3dHPF.png

This is Terminally Online : PC Gamer's very own MMO column. Every other week, I'll be sharing my thoughts on the genre, interviewing fellow MMO-heads like me, taking a deep-dive into mechanics we've all taken for granted, and, occasionally, bringing in guest writers to talk about their MMO of choice. Like our own Lincoln Carpenter, who's been enjoying a version of the galaxy far, far away from a long time ago.

After completing the initial tutorial on a private server for Star Wars Galaxies—the Star Wars-themed MMO that launched in 2003, was updated until 2005, and was shuttered in 2011—I was dumped out of a shuttle in Mos Eisley and into a warzone. Squads of rebel and imperial players were exchanging blaster fire and lobbing thermal detonators. When I asked the passing combatants why Tatooine was worth fighting over, a man in stormtrooper armor said I was lucky I wasn't PvP-flagged.

Despite the early-2000s assets and stiff animations, it was the most dynamic that an MMO had felt for me in years. But in the week I've spent revisiting Star Wars Galaxies, I've seen very little other excitement. I've killed no impressive enemies. I've done barely any quests. It's an MMO that's content to let me log in and do little of note whatsoever—and that's exactly what I've been missing.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/VdqTxaQMvu4KtxULVHxuD.png

In comparison, whenever the WoW itch gets strong enough for me to reup my subscription, I end up doing nothing but doing. Logging into WoW in 2026 means enduring a bombardment of refreshed weekly prompts and directives urging me to get on my flying mount and accelerate at breakneck speed towards whatever prescribed activity with prerequisite player count will provide my next predictable gear score increase.
A more civilized age

WoW has become a relentlessly efficient machine, ensuring players waste the least possible time while being propelled through seasonal ranks and escalating difficulty tiers. In terms of providing their users with those quantifiable successes, it's hard to argue that the MMOs of today aren't better designed than their older iterations. And yet, it's the moments when I step off the treadmill where they still feel the most magical.

When I can still find joy in WoW, it's not through the weekly content blitz. It's when I take the scenic route through an old leveling zone, and wonder what quest that dwarf running in the distance is doing. It's when I earn a grateful emote from a player of the opposite faction who can't otherwise thank me for helping them with a dicey fight. It's during the pinnacle of incidental MMO encounters: Receiving a sorely needed heal from a passing player who could've just as easily left me to die.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/STVfCeSkS5by4a2qdJsvX7.png

It's in those moments where it feels like the MMO rediscovers itself—where it recaptures the ways that multiplayer in a shared, persistent world can be a source of wonder, and not just a rote feature of the form. It's that wonder that motivated Star Wars Galaxies in 2003, and it's what its private server maintainers have worked to keep in suspended animation ever since.
Outer Rim living

My hours in Galaxies have been aimless ones. I've been casually puttering across the Tatooine wastelands, learning how to survey for minerals and water, how to harvest womp rat corpses for bones and how to use them to flavor what must be the world's worst tea—slowly gaining an understanding of its skill systems and crafting mechanics, but having no real idea whether I'm accomplishing anything another player would consider worthwhile.

I haven't used my blaster on anything more threatening than a nameless smuggler, and I'm not sure where I'd get a better shooting iron even if I wanted one. I could be answering the call to adventure as one of the galaxy's heroes, but the game's been content to let me ignore it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dX5Lv79Nrn6u4f9ZeDFE9C.png

And I've been content to go on ignoring. Because all that time I'm wasting out in the sands is time I've spent watching a bounty hunter tear by on a speeder bike and wondering what grim business he's on, or exchanging greetings with a Zabrak who's working on his carbine marksmanship. The hour I spent surveying eahiate iron deposits was one that led me through a sprawling, player-made city out in the dunes, its vacant tents and droid stalls and derelict cruisers parked in hand-built plazas proof that other players once shared that same space.

When I drift back through Mos Eisley, its scant environmental details and featureless wall textures feel vibrant, because the aliens, smugglers, and imperial agents I'll bump elbows with want nothing more than the pleasure of lingering there together.
Star Wars Galaxies has been dead for years—but it's a dead game that still remembers how to feel like a living world better than the market-leading MMOs that survived it.
